mapGenAutoStart.name: Start the map service with Foundry
mapGenAutoStart.hint: Asks the MCP server to start ComfyUI when a Gamemaster loads the world: the server reads this setting as soon as the module has connected. Set in the map generation window.

mapGenQuality.name: Map quality
mapGenQuality.hint: Low, medium or high: 8, 20 or 35 steps per map. Set in the map generation window.

maps.bridgeMissing: The MCP server is not connected.
maps.noAnswer: The MCP server did not answer within {seconds} seconds.
